tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa theg chen lam gyi snying po'o// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga theg chen lam gyi snying po zhes bya ba/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mkhyen rab rje btsun bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs dang dbyer mi phyed pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams chen rang bzhin rlan gyis rab brlan pa'i/ /tshad med snying rje'i sa bon las 'khrungs shing / /don gnyis phun tshogs 'bras bu legs bskrun pa'i/ /byang chub sems mchog myu gur phyag byas te/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /srid dang zhi ba'i phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /don gnyis 'dod pa'i smon pa sems bskyed kyi/ /cho ga rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin bshad/ /de la mtha' med pa'i sems can nyon mongs pa'i srin pos bzung nas las kyi lcags sgrog gis bcings shing 'chi bdag gi khar son pas sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gzir ba rnams sdug bsngal las bskyab par 'dod nas byang chub thob par 'dod pa rnams kyis byang chub chen por sems 'dir ldeb ma rgyab mdun gnyis chad yod/'jug pa de ni 'jug pa'i sems so zhes so/ /slob dpon mkhas pa dze tā ris smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems gnyis rim gyis sngon du byas shing bzung nas/ de'i 'og tu sdom pa bzung ba la mos pa brtan na de'i tshe/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /zhes sogs 'don pa kha bsgyur ba'i tshig lan gsum brjod pas sdom pa sbyin par bshad do/ /spang bya pham pa dang nyes byas la sogs pa la'ang / nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las gsungs pa bzhin 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi mdo kun las btus su'ang rgyal po dang / blon po'i ltung ba bcu dang / gzhan yang de'i steng du las dang po pa'i brgyad/ smon pa btang ba dang bcu dgu chags dang ser sna mi zad pas/ /slong la sbyin par mi byed dang /

/zhes sogs bslab pa kun las btus las bshad pa gsum ste/ mdor na rgyal sras zhi ba lhas rtsa ba'i ltung ba nyi shu rtsa gnyis bzhed par mngon no/ /shān+ti pa dang byang chub bzang pos/ rgyal blon gnyis kyi ltung ba ni byang sems kyi rtsa ltung ma yin gyi de dag la nyes pa lci bar dgongs nas ltung bar gsungs so zhes bzhed do/ /'phags pa thogs med dang / tsan+d+ra go mi la sogs mdo gzhan gyi rjes su 'brangs te/ nyon mongs pa drag pos slong ba'i phas pham pa 'dra ba bzhi dang / de bas kyang lci ba smon pa'i sems btang ba ste lngas byang sems kyi sdom pa gtong ba dang / pham 'dra bzhi kun dkris 'bring gis byas pa dang / kun dkris tha mas byas pas sdom pa mi gtong bar bzhed la/ nyon mongs can dang de ma yin pas byas pa'i nyes byas kyang tshul khrims gsum gyis mthun phyogs su gyur pa bzhi bcu zhe drug gsungs te/ rgyas par na byang sems kyi bslab gzhi grangs med pas bskal par yang brjod mi nus so/ /ltung ba de dag byung na slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med dang btsun pa zla ba la sogs pa ni kun dkris drag po pham pa byung bas sdom pa btang na slar len pas ltung ba las nges par 'byung ba dang / zag pa 'bring gis pham 'dra bzhi spyad na gang zag gsum yan chad la bshags pa dang / zag pa chung ngus pham 'dra de dag byas pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la gsum mi mchod ces sogs nyes byas rnams ni gang zag gcig gi mdun du bshags pa'am/ de lta bu'i yul med na phyi ma ni phyin chad mi bya bar sdom sems bskyed pas ltung ba las 'byung bar bshad la/ mkhan po 'phags mchog zhi ba'i lhas ni/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo'i rjes su 'brangs te/ de dag rtsa ba'i ltung ba ste/ /sems can dmyal ba chen po'i rgyu/ /rmi lam 'phags pa mkha' snying po'i/ /mdun du 'dug ste bshags par bya/ /zhes pa ltar tho rangs langs nas phyogs thams cad du yan lag lngas gtugs pa'i phyag bya ba dang /

a ka ru la sogs pa'i spos phul/ nam mkha' snying po la phyag 'tshal zhing mtshan nas brjod pa dang / lha'i bu skya rengs la gsol ba'i phrin las bcol te gnyid log na 'dzam bu'i gling du skya rengs shar ma thag byang sems nam mkha'i snying po rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham pa'i gzugs su bstan pa dang phrad de des thabs mkhas pas ltung ba 'chags su 'jug pas tshul des ltung ba las 'byung bar bzhed do/ /de la byang sems kyi sdom pa 'di ni bslab btus su nyon mongs chung ba'i bud med la'ang skye bar gsungs pas shugs la za ma ma ning dang / nyon mongs pa shin tu shas che ba'i bud med sogs sdom pa de'i yang zhing ma yin par gsal la/ jo bo chen pos/ so sor thar pa rigs bdun gyi/ /rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan pa dag /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi/ /skal ba yod kyi gzhan du min/ /zhes bshad pa'ang / sems bskyed tsam gyi skal ba med par gsungs pa ma yin gyi 'jug sdom gyi zhing ma yin pa la dgongs te/ byang sar so thar rigs bdun gyi sdom pa de byang sems kyi tshul khrims su gsungs pa dang yang mthun no/ /'o na yum dang rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdor/ lha klus sems bskyed par gsungs pa dang mi 'gal lam zhe na/ de dag dang mdo bskal bzang du de bzhin gshegs pa skar ma'i rgyal po sngon ba lang rdzir gyur pa sangs rgyas dbyangs sbyin la so rtsi'i 'dab ma phul nas sems bskyed par bshad pa la sogs pa rnams smon pa'i sems bskyed pa yin la za ma dang dud 'gro la sogs pa de dag 'jug sdom gyi zhing ma yin par 'dod pas 'gal ba ci yang med do/ /smon pa'i sems de ni cho gas gzhan la len pa la ltos pa'i nges pa med la/ 'jug sems dang sdom pa yang rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lha dang / jo bo rje la sogs pa ngo bo gcig tu bzhed par gsal te/ spyod 'jug tu/ gang nas bzung ste sems can khams/ /mtha' yas rab tu sgrol ba'i phyir/

/mi ldog pa yi sems kyis su/ /sems de yang dag blangs gyur pa/ /de nas bzung ste gnyid log gam/ /bag med gyur kyang bsod nams shugs/ /rgyun mi 'chad par du ma zhig /nam mkha' mnyam par rab tu 'byung / /zhes pa dang / byang chub lam sgron du/ 'jug sems bdag nyid sdom pa ma gtogs par/ /yang dag smon pa 'phel bar gyur ma yin/ /zhes dang / 'jug pa'i sems kyi bdag nyid sdom gnas pas/ /tshul khrims bslab pa gsum la legs bslabs pas/ /tshul khrims bslab pa gsum la gus cher 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /des na bzhed tshul de dag gi khyad par gyis dge bshes khyung la sogs pa kha cig dbu ma sems bskyed so sor 'jog pa ni de ltar ma nges shing / rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta su yang mi bzhed de/ slob dpon byang chub bzang po dang / mkhas pa a bha yā ka ras/ slob dpon klu sgrub dang 'phags pa thogs med la sogs pa'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga'i yi ge rnams phyogs gcig tu bsres pa cho ga mdzad pa'i phyir dang / slob dpon 'phags pa la sogs pa de dag kyang mdo'i dgongs pa bzhin mdzad pa yin na mdo de dang de dag kyang sems so so'i mdor gcig tu ma nges pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa slob dpon de dag gi dgongs pa bsdus te sems bskyed pa'i tshul la gnyis las/ dang po gsol ba btab pa ni/ rigs kyi bu'am bu mo gang rten dang bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas/ sems bskyed blang ba'i yul bla ma'i thad du song nas/ dkyil 'khor bya ba sngon du btang nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas thal mo sbyar te 'di skad ces/ rigs kyi bu'am btsun pa skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba can gyis byang chub kyi sems bdag la stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen des kyang nus pa ji lta ba bzhin du sbyin no zhes khas blang ngo / /gnyis pa gsol ba btab nas ji ltar bsgrub pa la gsum/

sngon 'gro'i chos dang / cho ga dngos kyi rim pa/ rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rten dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba bsam pa dang / 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa dang / de las thar pa'i thabs byang chub kyi sems kyi phan yon bsam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mi khom pa brgyad dang bral zhing 'byor ba'i yan lag bcu tshang ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi'i lus shin tu rnyed par dka' ste/ sdong po bkod par/ 'phags pa rgyal ba'i drod kyi skye mched kyi rnam thar las mi khom pa brgyad las ldog pa yang rnyed par dka'/ mir gyur pa yang rnyed par dka'/ dal ba phun sum tshogs pa rnam par dag pa yang rnyed par dka'/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba yang rnyed par dka'/ dbang po ma tshang ba med pa yang rnyed par dka'/ mi'i 'jig rten na chos dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos la nan tan byed pa yang rnyed par dka' na zhes pa dang / rgya mtsho gcig gnas gnya' shing bug pa dang / /ru sbal phrad pa las kyang dud 'gro las/ /mi nyid ches thob dka' bas mi dbang gis/ /dam chos spyad pas de 'bras mchis par mdzod/ /ces pa 'phags pas shes spring las gsungs pa dang / gang zhig thob nas skye ba'i rgya mtsho thar 'byin zhing / /byang chub mchog gi sa bon dge ba'ang 'debs gyur par/ /yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang yon tan lhag pa yi/ /mi nyid de ni su zhig 'bras bu med par byed/ /ces dang / mi yi dngos po shin tu rnyed dka' rnyed gyur nas/ /don du brnag pa gang yin de ni brtul te bsgrub/ /ces btsun pa zla bas gsungs shing / slob dpon dpa' bos/ legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog las kyang / rin chen gling phyin tshong pa ni/ /lag par stong par rang khyim bzhin/ /dge bcu'i las kyi lam med par/ /phyin nas yang ni 'thob ma yin/ /mi ma thob par bde ba ni/ /ji ltar de bde sdug bsngal nyid/ /de las pha rol bslus yod min/ /de las mchog tu rmongs pa med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/

/de la mi khom pa brgyad ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ log par lta ba 'dzin dang dud 'gro nyid/ /yi dwags nyid dang dmyal bar skye ba dang / /rgyal ba'i bka' med pa dang mtha' 'khob tu/ /kla klor skye dang glen cing lkug pa nyid/ /tshe ring lha dang gang yang rung bar ni/ /skye ba zhes bgyi mi khom skyon brgyad po/ /de dag dang bral khom pa rnyed nas ni/ /skye ba ldog pa'i slad du 'bad par mdzod/ /de dag spangs ba ni dal ba'o/ /'byor ba bcu ni/ mir gyur pa dang / yul dbus su skyes pa dang / dbang po ma tshang ba med pa dang / gnas la dad par gyur pa dang / las kyi mtha' ma log pa gang yin pa ni bdag gi 'byor pa ste/ des rang gi lus de yan lag lnga pos 'byor par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ba dang / dam pa'i chos ston pa dang / chos bstan pa rnams gnas pa dang / chos gnas pa rnams kyi rjes su 'jug pa dang / gzhan gyi phyir rjes su snying brtse bar byed pa ni gzhan gyi 'byor pa'o/ /de la mi khom par skyes pa ni gang du 'khor bzhi po rnams dang / dam pa rnams dang / yang dag par song ba rnams dang / skyes bu dam pa rnams mi 'gro ba'i mtha' 'khob kyi mi rkun ma dang kla klo rnams su skyes pa'o/ /mir gyur pa la sogs pa ni skyes pa bud med pho mo'i dbang po dang ldan pa dang / 'khor bzhi po rnams nas skyes bu dam pa'i bar dag 'gro ba'i yul dbus kyi mir skyes pa dang / glen pa dig pa lkug pa la sogs pa ma yin pa dang / yan lag dang nying lag dang rna ba sogs ma tshang ba med pas dge ba'i phyogs bsgrub pa'i skal ba yod pa dang / 'jig rten dang de las 'das pa'i dkar chos thams cad skye ba'i gnas ston pas gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la sems dad pa dang / des tshe 'di la mtshams med lnga gang rung rang gis ma byas shing byed du ma bcug pa dang / sems can thams cad la phan bde'i sems bskyed nas dka' ba stong phrag mang po dang /

tshogs gnyis chen pos grangs med pa gsum gyi lus tha ma thob nas byang chub snying po la 'dug ste/ sgrib pa lnga spangs nas phyogs mthun gyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun bsgoms nas mngon par 'tshang rgya ba dang / sangs rgyas de dag dang de'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'jig rten la thugs brtse bas bden bzhi las brtsams te gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi chos ni dam pa sangs rgyas dang / nyan thos rnams kyis bsten pa'i chos yin pas dang / sangs rgyas 'tsho zhing gzhes pas 'khor lo bskor te chos bstan nas mya ngan las 'das kyi bar ji srid sgrub pa mi nyams pa dang / chos mi nub par gnas pa'i bar dang / skye bo rnams la chos mngon du bya ba'i mthu yod par rig nas rang gi rtog pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i gdams pa dang rjes su bstan la rjes su 'jug pa dang / gzhan sbyin pa po dang sbyin bdag rnams kyis de dag la 'tsho ba'i yo byed stob pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs la lnga ste/ mi rtag pa/ sdug bsngal ba/ mi gtsang ba/ rang dbang med pa rtsod pa'i dus kyi nyes pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de lta bu'i dal 'byor de'ang gtan du ba ma yin te/ bde bar gshegs pas/ chu klung drag tu 'bab pa'i rgyun/ /ldog pa med pa ji lta bar/ /de bzhin mi yi tshe 'gro ba/ /slar mi ldog par 'gyur ba med/ /dka' ba nyid du thung ba dang / /de yang sdug bsngal ldan pa dag /myur ba kho nar 'jig 'gyur te/ /chu la dbyug gus bris pa bzhin/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa lha'i bzhi brgya pa las/ gsad par bya ba'i phyugs rnams ltar/ /'chi ba kun gyi thun mong zhing / /gzhan yang 'chi bar snang gyur na/ /khyod la 'chi bdag 'jigs cis med/ /ces dang / rdo rje rta dbyangs kyis/ gang du sa rnams bsregs gyur te/ /lhun po'ang thal bar 'jig pa dang / /rgya mtsho'i chu yang skams 'gyur na/ /lus can de dag lta ci smos/ /ci ste sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/

/rdo rje'i sku yang mi rtag na/ /chu shing snying po 'dra ba yi/ /lus can gzhan rnams smos ci dgos/ /zhes mya ngan bsal ba las bshad cing / slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis kyang / mar me me lce shugs drag rlung gis bskyod pa lta'i/ /tshe 'di skad cig gnas pa'i gdeng yang yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / slob dpon ma khol gyis kyang / ji ltar bsad bya'i mi dag me tog phreng btags sil sgrol mis bskor te/ /gsod par khrid pa gom pa re re bor bas 'chi nye'i sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /de bzhin longs spyod la gnas nyin re 'chi bdag drung du 'gro byed kyis/ /kye khyed 'byor pa dag gis yid ni dregs pa dag tu ma byed cig /ces phyin ci log bzhi spang ba las gsungs shing / 'di ni ma byas brtsams pa dang / /'di phye+ed byas par gnas pa la/ /blo bur 'chi bdag 'ongs nas ni/ /kyi hud bcom zhes sems par 'gyur/ /zhes slob dpon zhi ba'i lhas kyang bshad do/ /gnyis pa la bzhi las/ dang po khams gsum pa spyi'i sdug bsngal ni/ de ltar nges par 'chi zhing myur du 'chi yang ma shi'i bar dang shi nas kyang bde ba'i go skabs yod dam zhe na/ 'khor ba pa la bde ba mnog dang ldan pa cung zad kyang med de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gang mi rtag pa de sdug bsngal ba rnam par 'gyur ba'i chos can lags so/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa lhas/ mi rtag pa la nges par gnod/ /gang la gnod yod de bde min/ /de phyir mi rtag gang yin de/ /thams cad sdug bsngal zhes byar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / lus can rnams la bkres sogs kyis/ /gnod pa rtag tu yod 'gyur na/ /gnod bzhin pa ni bde 'o zhes/ /rnam pa kun tu rigs ma yin/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zla ba grags pas bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel par/ gang zhig yang dang yang du 'chi de bde min zhing / /gang na rtag tu nad gzhi yod de rnal ma min/ /gang du rgyud pa mdun na rtag de 'byor min la/ /gang zhig tshul ma yin pas btags te nor ma yin/

/zhes bshad do/ /dran pa nyer bzhag las kyang / lha dag bag med pa yis nyams/ /mi rnams 'tsho ba thung bas nyams/ /dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams/ /yi dwags bkres dang skom pas nyams/ /sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /'khor bar khab kyi rtse mo la/ /bde ba nyid ni cung zad med/ /ces dang / mgon po byams pas rgyud bla mar/ mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med/ /de yi sdug bsngal me mtshon kha ba rgya tsha reg skyes bzhin/ /lha la 'chi 'pho mi la yongs tshol sdug bsngal zhes byar rtogs pa'i phyir/ /shes rab ldan pa lha mi'i dbang phyug la yang mngon par 'dod med do/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal la drug las/ dang po dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal la gsum las/ dang po tsha dmyal gyi sdug bsngal ni/ yang sos thig nag bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod ngu 'bod chen po/ tsha ba rab tu tsha ba/ mnar med kyi bar gyi gzhi'i sdug bsngal dang / de re re la yang nye 'khor bcu drug re'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med de/ chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs kyis/ gang gi phyir ni lo stong phrag /mang por yang ni de dag tu/ /btags shing btags shing yang 'tsho bas/ /de phyir yang sos yin par bshad/ /gang phyir de ni shing bzhin du/ /thig nag btab nas sog le dag /'bar ba yis ni gshog byed kyi/ /de phyir thig nag yin par bshad/ /gang phyir bsdus nas der 'dor dang / /yang dag sreg par byed pas na/ /de yi phyir na bsdus 'joms te/ /de ltar ming gi don mthun grags/ /der ni drag po'i me dag gis/ /rgyun mi 'chad par bsregs pas na/ /gang phyir skad ni drag 'byin pa/ /de phyir de dag ngu 'bod yin/ /mes bsregs pas ni drag phyir dang / /ngu 'bod pa yang che phyir dang / /lci zhing che ba nyid kyi phyir/ /de ni ngu 'bod chen po yin/ /gang phyir rtag tu mes brdungs pa/ /drag po skye ba de yi phyir/

/'jig rten du ni tsha ba'i ming / /don dang mthun par grags pa yin/ /me ni rab tu drag po yis/ /der 'khod sems can rab tsha byed/ /tsha ba phul du byung ba de/ /de phyir rab tu tsha bar gsungs/ /me drag der ni lus dag gi/ /rus pa dag kyang lhags par 'gyur/ /de phyir bde ba'i skabs med pa/ /de phyir mnar med yin par bshad/ /ces dran pa nye bar bzhag las bshad cing / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis kyang / sems can nyes par spyad pa spyod rnams la/ /yang sos thig nag rab tu tsha ba dang / /bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod mnar med la sogs pa'i/ /dmyal ba rnams su rtag tu sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /zhes dang / tsan+d+ra go mis kyang / dmyal me du ba che bku mnam pa 'thul bas gnam mdog 'gyur/ /me lces lag mang rnam par 'phros nas phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor khebs/ /rus gong dkar dum phreng ba'i rgyan gyis spud pa skyi g.ya' ba/ /glang chen lpags gyon bsdigs thabs kye ma kye hud zer ba bzhin/ /la lar me stag cher 'phro 'khrugs pa 'ur sgra tog yar la/ /gzhag gi bab na skad ngan bod pa'i rtse zhi chil chil 'bar/ /brang gi rus pa'i khong du thal ba lhag lhag sgra grag pa/ /bskal pa'i dus kyi me yis bskyab tu med pa'i nang du lhung / /zhes so/ /brgyad po re re la nye 'khor gyi sdug bsngal yang / slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ brgyad po kun la lhag bcu drug /de dag gi ni dngos gzhi na/ /me mar mur dang ro myags 'dam/ /spu gri'i lam sogs chu bo yin/ /zhes dang / de dag gi sdug bsngal gyi khyad par gzhan yang / kha cig lcags kyi gsal shing rab 'bar ba/ /tsher ma can la kun tu brgyud par bgyid/ /kha cig lcags kyi mche ba ldan pa'i khyi/ /gtum pos 'bad cing lag pa gnam du bsgreng / /dbang med gzhan dag lcags mchu rnon po dang / /sen mo mi bzad ldan pa'i khwa rnams 'thog /kha cig srin bu sbur ba sna tshogs dang /

/sha sbrang sbrang bu mchu ring khri phrag dang / /reg na mi bzad rma srol cher 'byin pa/ /za bar bgyid cing 'dre ldog smre sngags 'don/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa grang ba'i dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ chu bur can la sogs pa grang ba'i dmyal ba brgyad na'ang sdug bsngal dpag tu med de/ lhags pa dpe med rus pa la yang thi ba yi/ /lus brebs 'dar shing bskur nas gum gum por 'dug pa/ /chu bur brgya byung rdol ba las byung srog chags kyi/ /ral gris 'bad nas zhag dang chu ser rkang bcas 'dzag /dkos thag so tham skra dang spu rnams g.yengs gyur pa/ /mig dang rna ba lkog ma gnod pas kun gzir zhing / /lus dang sems kyi bar du klong klong por gyur nas/ /grang ba'i dmyal bar gnas shing shin tu 'o dod 'bod/ /ces so/ /gsum pa nye tshe ba'i sdug bsngal yang / gro bzhin skyes kyi rtogs brjod du/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram mya ngan gyi thang la sogs par gnas te/ nyin par dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal mtshan mo lha'i dpal 'byor myong ba la sogs yod par bshad de/ ji skad du/ nyin par gzhan gyi srog bcad cing / /mtshan mo yon tan tshul khrims ldan/ /las de'i 'bras bu bzang po dang / /sdig tos 'di ni myong ba yin/ /zhes dang / mtshan mo byi po byed la chags/ /nyin bar tshul khrims yon tan ldan/ /las de'i 'bras bu bzang po dang / /sdig tos 'di ni myong ba yin/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal yang 'dzam bu'i gling gi dpag tshad lnga brgya'i 'og na grong khyer ser skya zhes bya ba yod la/ der yi dwags kyi rgyal po gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po zhes pa gnas shing / de'i 'khor du gtogs pa dang / 'dzam bu'i gling sogs su'ang yi dwags kyi rigs dpag tu med cing mdor bsdu na/ phyi'i sgrib pa can/ nang gi sgrib pa can/ zas skom gyi sgrib pa can gsum du 'dus so/ /de'ang / smad rigs 'gas ni rnag dang phyi sa dang /

/khrag sogs mi gtsang ba yang mi rnyed do/ /phan tshun gdong du 'tshog cing mgrin pa nas/ /lba ba byung ba smin pa'i rnag 'tshal lo/ /yi dwags rnams la sos kha'i dus su ni/ /zla ba'ang tshe la dgun ni nyi ma'ang grang / /ljon shing 'bras bu med 'gyur 'di dag gis/ /bltas pa tsam gyis rlung yang skams par 'gyur/ /zhes slob dpon 'phags pas gsungs shing / btsun pa zla bas kyang / khab mig tsam gyis kha la dpag tshad mang 'jigs pa'i/ /lto can nyam thag rgya mtsho chen po'i chu 'thungs kyang / /mgul phugs yangs pa nyid du phyin par ma gyur par/ /kha yi dug gis chu yi thigs pa'ang skams par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / bshes spring du/ kha cig lpags rus lus shing gcer bus te/ /ta la yang tog skams pa lta bu lags/ /kha cig mtshal zhing kha nas 'bar ba ste/ /zas su 'bar ba'i khar 'bab phye leb 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal yang / de nyid du/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang bsad pa dang / /bcings dang rdeg sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa/ /zhi 'gyur dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni/ /gcig la gcig za shin tu mi zad pa/ /kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa dang / /sha dang lpags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dbang med gzhan dag rdog pa lag pa dang / /lcag dang lcags kyu btab pas btab ste bkol/ /zhes so/ mi'i sdug bsngal yang / de nyid du/ mi ni yang dag nyid du mi bde zhing / /mi rtag bdag med mi gtsang rig par bgyi/ /zhes pa dang / rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las/ rgyal po chen po/ rga ba dar la bab pa 'joms shing 'ong / nad ni nad med pa 'joms shing 'ong / rgud pa ni phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'joms shing 'ong / 'chi ba ni srog 'joms shing 'ong / de dag la mgyogs pas bros pa'am/ stobs kyis bzlog pa'am/ nor gyis bzlog pa'am/ rdzas dang / sngags dang / sman rnams kyis zhi bar bya ba sla ba ma yin no/ /zhes pa dang / 'phags pa lhas/ sdug bsngal gyi ni rgyu mang po/

/nad rnams dang gzhan snang 'gyur ba/ /de snyed du ni mi rnams la/ /bde ba'i rgyu dag snang ma yin/ /zhes dang / btsun pa zla bas kyang / shin tu mi zad dri nga mi gtsang gcer bas 'gags/ /rab tu dog pa mun nag 'thibs por 'dug pa'i mi/ /mngal gnas dmyal ba lta bu'i nang du de zhugs nas/ /lus yongs bskum la sdug bsngal chen pos brnag dgos so/ /zhes skye ba'i sdug bsngal dang / de ni rim gyis til mar btsir bcad sra ba yi/ /btsir ba ltar byas de nas ji zhig ltar de btsa'/ /'on kyang mod la de srog mi 'dor gang yin pa/ /sdug bsngal nye bar spyad pa'i rnam thar tho btsal mod/ /ces rtsa ba'i sdug bsngal dang / de nas de ni lhu tshigs rnams 'bye zhing / /blo yang bslad 'gyur 'gro ba nyams par 'gyur/ /lus kyang de nas shig shig por 'gyur la/ /nges par sdig pa 'phel ba kho nar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / de nas de ni mi 'dod bzhin du mgor/ /brtse med rga bas rdog pas nan gnan nas/ /skra dkar lcags kyu bdar ba rnon po yis/ /glang chen rdzi 'us glang chen bzhin du 'debs/ /zhes rgas pa'i sdug bsngal dang / nye du'i skye bo ngud mo'i 'chi rgyun can/ /sdug bsngal snying ni rje rje lta bu bltas/ /gnad kyi gshis su 'dzems par gzir nas ni/ /shin tu mi bzad mun rum 'jug par 'gyur/ /'bad pa lhur blangs bsrung bar bya ba'i lus/ /yid 'ong 'dris pa rnam par 'dor bar 'gyur/ /zhes 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal te gzhan yang sdug bsngal dpag tu med do/ /lnga pa lha ma yin gyi sdug bsngal yang de dag rang bzhin gyis nga rgyal che ba dang / lha'i dpal la phrag dog dang rnam smin gyi sgrib pa can yin pas sdug bsngal che ste/ lha min dag na'ang rang bzhin gyis lha yi/ /dpal la sdang phyir yid kyi sdug bsngal che/ /de dag blo dang ldan na'ang 'gro ba yi/ /sgrib pas bden pa mthong ba ma mchis so/ /zhes so/ /drug pa lha la'ang sdug bsngal gsum ci rigs par yod cing khyad par du 'dod pa'i lha la 'chi ltas dang nye ba'i 'chi ltas lnga byung ba'i tshe 'chi 'pho ba'i sdug bsngal chen po yod de/

mtho ris na yang bde chen de dag gi/ /'chi 'pho'i sdug bsngal nyid ni de bas che/ /zhes bshes spring las bshad cing / gzhan las kyang / kyi hud shing rta sna tshogs tshal/ /kyi hud rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab/ /kyi hud sdug pa'i rnam shes lnga/ /smre sngags 'don zhing sa la lhung / /zhes so/ /de la 'chi bar nges pa'i snga ltas lnga ni/ lus kyi kha dog mi sdug 'gyur ba dang / /stan la mi dga' me tog phreng rnying dang / /gos la dri ma chags dang lus la ni/ /sngon chad med pa'i rdul byung zhes bgyi ba/ /mtho ris 'chi 'pho sbron bgyid snga ltas lnga/ /lha yul gnas pa'i lha rnams la 'byung ste/ /zhes pa bshes spring du gsungs so/ /gsum pa de dag gis ma nges pa'i sdug bsngal gzhan yang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ pha nyid bu nyid ma nyid chung ma nyid/ /skye bo dgra gyur pa dag bshes nyid dang / /bzlog pa nyid du mchis pas de slad du/ /'khor ba dag na nges pa 'ga' ma mchis/ /zhes pa dang / brgya byin 'jig rten mchod 'os gyur nas kyang / /las kyi dbang gis phyir yang sa steng lhung / /'khor los sgyur rgyal nyid du gyur nas kyang / /'khor ba dag tu yang bran nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dal gyis 'bab par lha yi bu mo ni/ /gdong mdzes gser gyi pad ma ldan zhugs nas/ /slar yang dmyal bar chu bo rab med pa/ /tsha sgo bzod glags chu tshan 'jug 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / lha yul 'dod bde shin tu chen po dang / /tshangs nyid chags bral bde ba thob nas slar/ /mnar med me yi bud shing gyur pa yis/ /sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad pa bsten 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs dpag tu med pa gsungs shing / mdor na bsags pa'i mtha' mdzad/ bslang ba'i mtha' 'gyel/ phrad pa'i mtha' 'bral/ gson pa'i mtha' 'chi ba yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ bsags pa kun gyi mtha' mdzad cing / /bslang ba'i mtha' ni 'gyel bar 'gyur/ /phrad pa'i mtha' ni 'bral ba ste/

/gson pa'i mtha' ni 'chi ba yin/ /zhes ched du brjod par gsungs so/ /bzhi pa 'dod yon la srid pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ de ltar sdug bsngal yang yang 'dod pa'i yon tan la longs spyod pa'i bde bas dga' bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ ma yin te/ ri dwags nyid ni sgra tsam gyis/ /reg pas glang po brlag par 'gyur/ /gzugs nyid kyis ni phye leb ste/ /ro yis nya ni rnam par brlag /bung ba dri la chags pa ste/ 'di dag rgyu ni re re yis/ /skyes bu dag ni gcig la yang / /lnga po 'di dag rtag ldan zhing / /nyin mtshan du ni rab 'joms na/ /bde gnas ji ltar thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las kyang / bsam brlag 'dod la sred pa yis/ /bdag dang gzhan yang phung bar 'gyur/ /kar sha pa ni'i char phab kyang / /'dod pa rnams kyis ngoms mi 'gyur/ /'dod pa mdog chung nyes mang bar/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi khong du chud/ /lha yi 'dod pa rnams la yang / /lha min dga' bar mi 'gyur gyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang nyan thos rnams/ /sred pa zad pas dgyes par 'gyur/ /gangs can dang ni mnyam pa yi/ /gser gyi ngo bo yod gyur kyang / /nor des cis kyang mi tshim par/ /rtogs par gyis la legs par spyod/ /ces dang / bshes spring du'ang / g.yo ba'i sems ni thos mtshungs bu lta bur/ /gtar bzhin srog dang 'dra bar bsrung bya ste/ /gdug pa dug dang mtshon dang dgra bo dang / /me bzhin 'dod pa'i bde la yid byung mdzod/ /'dod pa rnams ni phung ba bskyed pa ste/ /rgyal ba'i dbang pos kim pa'i 'bras 'drar gsungs/ /de dag yang bgyi de yi lcags sgrog gis/ /'khor ba'i brtson rar 'jig rten 'di dag bcings/ /gang dag dbang po drug yul rnams la ni/ /rtag tu mi rtag g.yo dang gang dag gcig /g.yul ngor dgra tshogs las rgyal de dag las/ /mkhas rnams dang po dpa' rab lags par 'tshal/ /zhes dang / slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis/

yul dang dug mtshungs dang po myong ba tsam na bde/ /yul dang dug mtshungs rnam smin rtsub pas mi bzad pa/ /yul dang dug mtshungs gti mug mun pas thibs por byed/ /yul dang dug mtshungs shugs bzlog dka' zhing g.yo ba yin/ /dug dang yul rnams blo yis nges par brtag byas nas/ /nyes na dug sla mi bzad rang bzhin yul rnams ni/ /dug ni skye ba cig la dug tu 'gyur bar zad/ /yul ni tshe rabs gzhan na'ang dug tu 'gyur bar byed/ /ces dang / ji ltar glang bu khron zab kha nas 'khrungs pa yi/ /rtswa lo kham 'ga' tsam la yid ni chags gyur pa/ /rnyed pa grub pa med par g.yang du lhung ba ltar/ /'tsho ba'i 'jig rten bde ldan 'dod pa'ang de dang 'dra/ /zhes so/ /gzhon nu ma bdun gyi rtogs brjod gsang ba sbyin gyis mdzad pa las/ gang 'di thog mtha' med nas 'gro ba dang / /'gro bar 'gyur dang gnas pa'i sems can lus/ /de ni gsod 'joms rten dang mtshungs pas na/ /sdig pa'i gzhir gyur 'dod pas ci zhig bya/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa mi gtsang ba'i nyes dmigs ni/ rang dang gzhan bud med kyi lus ni khrus byug la sogs pas gtsang zhing yid du 'ong bas bde ba'i rgyu 'o zhe na/ de'ang yod pa ma yin te/ slob dpon mā tṛ tse ṭas/ shin tu gtsang ba'i dar dang dri zhim me tog gur kum la/ /de dang de ni gang du reg na skad cig gis ni mi gtsang 'gyur/ /rma yi sgo dgu dag ni mi gtsang dri yis ljin zhing 'dzag gyur gang / /de la khyed ni skal bzang yin zhes 'dir ni rlom sems ji ltar byed/ /ces dang / 'phags pa lhas kyang / dngos po gtsang ba thams cad kyi/ /tha ma gang du dmigs 'gyur ba/ /de la gtsang ba yod do zhes/ /blo ldan mi ni gang zhig smra/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zla ba grags pas kyang / /pad ma kha dog bzang zhing dri bsung ldan/ /gtsang bar gyur kyang gzhan gyis bsnams pa yis/ /skye bo de la mi gtsang bar 'gyur la/

/de yi phyir ni lus ni mi gtsang 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa rang dbang med pa'i nyes pa ni/ de lta na'ang rgyal po la sogs skye dgu la dbang byed cing / bdag nyid kyang bu dang chung ma la sogs bdag gi rnams la dbang bsgyur ba'o snyam na/ de lta'ang ma yin te/ 'phags pa lhas/ gzhan gyis bskul de byed pa gang / /de ni sa steng blun zhes bya/ /khyod dang mtshungs pa'i gzhan dbang gzhan/ /'ga' yang yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes dang / mā tṛ tse ṭas/ phung po lnga po 'di la yul dang yul can nyid du brtags nas ni/ /bdag dang bdag gi med pa dag la nga dang nga yir des byas nas/ /'jig rten rmongs pa 'di ni 'jig rten skom gyis gdungs pa mya ngam du/ /rmig rgyu'i chu yi chu bur las byung snod du 'thung snyam sems dang mtshungs/ /zhes dang / de ni rgyu las byung zhing gnas pa'ang rang gi rkyen gyi dbang las gyur/ /dus kyis rgas shing tshe dang bsod nams zad la sogs pas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /skye la dbang byar ma yin rgas la ma yin shi la dbang med na/ /bdag gi chung ma zhes smra ngo tsha bar ni ji ltar de ma gyur/ /ces dang / lugs kyi bstan bcos las kyang / gzhon nu'i dus na pha ma'i dbang du gyur/ /lang tsho'i dus na chung ma'i dbang du gyur/ /rgan po'i dus na byis pa'i dbang gyur pas/ /blun po nam yang rang dbang yod ma yin/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa rtsod dus kyi nyes dmigs ni/ de ltar 'khor ba nyes pa du ma'i 'byung gnas yin zhing khyad par du lta ba dang tshe dang sems can dang dus dang nyon mongs pa'i snyigs ma ste snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus 'dir/ nyes rnams stobs che zhing mang ste/ slob dpon ma khol gyis/ tshul khrims las nyams thos pa'i nor bral 'dod pas 'di nyid cung zad mchod par byed/ /nyes med tshul khrims ldan la yon tan ro la rgyab phyogs zhe sdang cung zad nyes pa bkod/ /rab byung rnams la khyim pas las bsko de nas rab byung des kyang khyim pa mgu bar byed/

/ci spyad 'dir ni 'gro ba'i khyim du ma lus dus kyi snyigs ma zhugs pa yin/ /zhes pa dang / bcud rnams sa 'thungs dngos rnams don chung lha rnams char ni 'bebs mi byed/ /rlung rnams rab tu drag ldang lo tog rnams ni mi smin skye mi 'gyur/ /skyes la ser 'bab sa rnams rtsod pa'i dus kyis dbang bsgyur 'bras bu med/ /dngos rnams mthu med dgos pa bsgrub rnams nyams pa thob la rtag /ces dang / dus rnams 'khrul zhing sa la bcud rnams nub 'gyur nyi zla log par rgyu/ /chung ma khyod la gcugs pas 'brel ba'i sems med dman pa rnams ni 'thon por 'gyur/ /rgyal po chos spangs nor rnams mchog tu don gnyer bu rnams pha la sdang / /kyi hud sdug bsngal rtsod pa'i dus ni nyer gnas bsod nams gnyer ba nags su song / /zhes pa dang / legs spyad brgya phrag dri yis bsgos pa yis/ /skal ldan nub cing dus ni 'das par 'gyur/ /pad gzhon rtsa ba'i skud pa ji bzhin du/ /dkar po'i chos rnams shin tu phra bar gyur/ /blo ldan skyes bu gtam mkhas dri mas bsgo/ /'gro 'di dga' med dga' ston zin pa bzhin/ /bdag nyid chen po 'di ni yang dag 'gags/ /gang na yod tan rnams kyi stobs phra la/ /yon tan la bdud babs pas gcod byed cing / /skye bo smra ba la brten 'tsho bar byed/ /ces sogs rgyas par bshad cing / bzhi brgya pa las/ slob dpon 'phags pa lhas/ sngar gyi sa bdag dge rnams kyis/ /'jig rten bu ltar bskyangs pa de/ /rtsod dus chos la brten rnams kyis/ /ding sang ri dwags dgon par byas/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa de las thar ba'i thabs byang chub sems kyi phan yon bsam pa ni/ de lta bu'i rang gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rnams bsal ba'i byang chub chen po don du gnyer bas byang chub la dad pa'i blo brtan par bya ba yin te/ sdug bsngal mthar byin 'dod pa dang / /bde ba'i mthar yang 'gro 'dod pas/

/dad pa'i rtsa ba brtan bya ste/ /byang chub la yang blo brtan bya/ /zhes bslab btus las gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar na dad pa'i rtsa ba brtan par byas la bsod nams kyi tshogs rnams bsdu ba'i phyir dang / 'og nas ji skad 'byung ba'i phan yon rnams 'thob par bya ba'i phyir yang chub kyi sems brtan par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das la rgyal bu seng ges zhus par/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sems can thams cad thar bya'i phyir/ /byang chub don du sems btud pa/ /des na chos rnams bsdu ba 'thob/ /des ni dga' ba'ang 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /sems bskyed pa des phan yon ci zhig 'thob ce na/ rnam pa drug ste/ dang po nyes chen sel ba ni/ de ltas dge ba nyam chung nyid la brtag /sdig pa stobs chen shin tu mi zad pa/ /de ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems min pa/ /dge gzhan gang gis zil gyis gnon par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa bde mchog thob pa'i rgyur yang 'gyur te/ bskal pa du mar rab dgongs mdzad pa yi/ /thub dbang rnams kyis 'di nyid phan par gzigs/ /'di ni tshad med skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bde mchog bde blag nyid du thob par byed/ /ces so/ /gsum pa phan bde 'dod pas brtan par bzung ba ni/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal brgya phrag gzhom 'dod cing / /sems can mi bde bsal bar 'dod pa dang / /bde mang brgya phrag spyod par 'dod pas kyang / /byang chub sems nyid rtag tu gtang mi bya/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa tshe 'di'i phan yon ni/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pa'i phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa phan yon dpe'i sgo nas bstan pa la lnga las/ dang po gser 'gyur rtsi dang mtshungs pa ni/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bur/ /mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku/

/rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas na/ /byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brtan zungs/ /zhes so/ /byams pa'i rnam thar las kyang / rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na dngul chu'i rigs gser du snang ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de srang gcig gis lcags srang stong gser du bsgyur ro/ /de bzhin du thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sems bskyed pa'i bcud kyis len dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo ba'i ye shes kyis yongs su bzung ba ni las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i lcags thams cad zad par byas te chos thams cad mkhyen pa'i gser gyi kha dog tu byed kyang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sems bskyed pa'i bcud kyi len gcig po de ni las dang nyon mongs pa'i lcags thams cad kyis kyang nyon mongs pa'am zad par bya bar mi nus so/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa yid bzhin nor dang mtshungs pa ni/ 'gro ba'i ded dpon gcig pus tshad med blos/ /legs par yongs su brtags na rin che ba'i/ /'gro ba'i nad dang bral bar 'dod pa rnams/ /rin chen byang chub sems legs brtan por bzung / /zhes dang / sdong po bkod pa'i mdor/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na ji srid du nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od kyis snang bar byed pa de srid du nor dang 'bru dang rin po che dang sa le sbram dang dngul dang me tog dang spos dang phreng ba dang byug pa dang gos dang longs spyod dang gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyis nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i rin du mi bzod do/ /de bzhin du ji srid du dus gsum du thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi chos kyi dbyings kyi yul du snang bar mdzad pa de srid du lha dang mi dang sems can thams cad dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba zag pa dang bcas pa dang zag pa med pa gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyis byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i nor bu rin po che chen po dbang gi rgyal po'i rin du mi chog go

/zhes so/ gsum pa dpag bsam shing dang mtshungs pa ni/ dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni/ /'bras bu bskyed nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid/ /byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang / /'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa las/ btsun pa shā ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste dper na rgya mtsho chen por chu'i thigs pa lhung ba ni bskal pa'i mthar thug gi bar du bar ma dor yongs su zad pa'am gtugs pa med do/ /de bzhin du byang chub tu yongs su bsngos pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ni/ byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du bar dor yongs su zad pa'am gtugs pa med do zhes so/ /bzhi pa grogs dpa' bo dang mtshungs pa ni/ sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas na yang / /dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa chen po ltar/ /gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol 'gyur ba/ /de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi brten/ /zhes pa dang / mdo de nyid las/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na/ skyes bu dpa' bo la yang dag par brten pa ni dgra bo thams cad kyis mi 'jigs so/ /de bzhin du byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i skyes bu dpa' bo la yang dag par brten pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni nyes par spyod pa'i dgra bo thams cad kyis mi 'jigs so/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa dus mtha'i me dang mtshungs pa ni/ des ni dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig chen rnams/ /skad cig gis ni nges par sreg par byed/ /ces dang / yang de nyid las/ nyes par byed pa thams cad sreg par byed pas bskal pa'i me lta bu'o/ /zhes so/ drug pa sdong po bkod par gsungs pa'i phan yon ni/ gzhan yang smon pa'i sems de'i phan yon dpag tu med pa dag byams mgon blo gros chen po dang ldan pas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang la bshad do/ /sdong pa bkod par/ rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o/

/'gro ba thams cad kyi dkar po'i chos rnam par 'phel bar byed pas zhing lta bu'o/ /'jig rten thams cad brten pas sa lta bu'o/ /dbul pa thams cad yang dag par spyod pas rnam thos kyi bu lta bu'o/ /byang chub kyi sems thams cad yongs su bsrung bas pha lta bu'o/ /don thams cad yang dag par sgrub pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'o/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pas bum pa bzang po lta bu'o/ /nyon mongs pa'i dgra pham par bya ba la mdung thung lta bu'o/ /tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa 'gegs pas go cha lta bu'o/ /nyon mongs pa'i mgo ltung bar byed pas ral gri lta bu'o/ /nyon mongs pa'i shing gcod pas sta re lta bu'o/ /'tshe ba thams cad skyob pas mtshon cha lta bu'o/ /'khor ba'i chu nang na gnas pa steng du 'byin pas mchil ma lta bu'o/ /sgrib pa dang khebs pa'i rtsa ba thams cad rnam par 'thor bas rlung gi dkyil 'khor lta bu'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang smon lam thams cad bsdus pa'i phyir mdor bstan pa lta bu'o/ /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten la mchod rten lta bu ste/ rigs kyi bu de ltar byang chub kyi sems ni yon tan de dag dang yon tan gyi bye brag tshad med pa gzhan dang yang ldan no/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa cho ga dngos la gsum ste/ sbyor ba'i dang / dngos gzhi'i dang / rjes kyi cho ga'o/ /dang po la brgyad de/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ phyag bya ba/ skyabs su 'gro ba/ sdig pa bshags pa/ dge ba la yi rang ba/ 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba/ gsol ba gdab pa/ yongs su bsngo ba'o/ /dang po la rnam pa bcu gcig gi dang po bdag pos ma bzung ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 'khor byang sems dang bcas pa thams cad re re'i drung du'ang rang nyid lus dpag tu med par bzang spyod las ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du gnas par mos te bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mchod pa rnams so sor rdzogs par phul bar bsams te/

bdag gi rjes su bzlas pa mdzod/ rin chen sems de gzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos/ /dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras/ /yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la legs par mchod/ /me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang / /sman gyi rnam pa gang dag yod pa dang / /'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang / /chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba ci yod dang / /rin chen ri bo dang ni de bzhin du/ /nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' dang / /ljon shing me tog rgyan spras spud pa dang / /shing gang 'bras bzang yal ga dud pa dang / /lha sogs 'jig rten na yang dri dang ni/ /spos dang dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing / /ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog rnam pa dang / /gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams ni/ /mtsho dang rdzing bu pad mas brgyan pa dag /ngang pa skad snyan shin tu yid 'ong ldan/ /nam mkha' rab 'byam khams kyi mthas gtugs pa/ /yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun/ /blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog /sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na/ /yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis/ /bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes/ /bdag ni bsod nams mi ldan bkren chen te/ /mchod pa'i nor gzhan bdag la cang ma mchis/ /des na gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon gyis ni/ /bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig /ces brjod do/ /gnyis pa lus 'bul ba'i mchod pa ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems rnams la rang gi lus bka' rjes su bsgrub pa'i 'bangs su 'bul bar mos pa mdzod la rjes zlos gyi+is/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni/ /bdag gi lus kun gtan du dbul bar bgyi/ /sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyod kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi/ /bdag ni khyed kyis yongs su bzung bas na/ /srid na mi 'jigs sems can phan par bgyi/

/sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' bgyid cing / /sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do/ /zhes brjod do/ /bkru zhing phyi ba'i mchod pa ni/ rang rang gi gnas nas mdun gyi nam mkha' 'am byug ris kyi dkyil 'khor du spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la bsnyel gso ba'i phyir sku bkru zhing phyi bar mos pas tshig gi rjes zlos mdzod/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba ltar/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'od chags bla bre bres pa der/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang ba klu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi 'o/ /zhes brjod do/ /bzhi pa gos dang rgyan gyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ yang / sangs rgyas la sogs pa rnams la legs par kha bsgyur ba'i gos dang / byams pa la sogs byang sems rnams la gos ka tsa lin dha la sogs pa sna tshogs dang lhab lhub dang dbu rgyan sogs phul bar mos pas rjes zlos mdzod/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' dam pa shin tu dri zhim 'bul/ /gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang / /rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis/ /mi pham kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang / /'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la 'ang brgyan par bgyi/ /zhes brjod do/ /lnga pa byug pa dang me tog gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ ha ri'i tsan+dan la sogs dri mchog gi byug pa dang / dpag bsam gyi shing gi me tog dang / me tog man dā ra dang / ma l+li ka la sogs pa'i phreng ba yid du 'ong ba rnams phul bar mos pas rjes zlos mdzod/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi/ /dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/

/'od chags 'bar bas de dag byug par bgyi/ /thub dbang mchod gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i/ /me tog man dā ra dang pad ma dang / /ut+pal la sogs dri zhim thams cad dang / /phreng ba spel legs yid 'ong rnams 'dir yang ldeb mdun rgyab drug rtsa ba'i ma dpe ma tshang bas chad yod/shes la dgod pa'i slad du ji ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas gzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du sems can thams cad bsgral ba dang / sems can thams cad dgrol ba dang / sems can thams cad dbugs dbyung ba dang / sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la dgod pa'i slad du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po de dag gis dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang bzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa/ chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid kyis rang gi sems gzod ma nas ma skyes pa/ stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyi byang chub sems bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis bdud dpung dang bcas pa de dag pham par mdzad de/ nyid mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang / bdud dpung dang bcas pa mtha' dag pham par byas te bdag mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bgyi'o/ /ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag nyid mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba de bzhin du/

bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar bgyi'o/ /ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis nyid mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas tshogs yongs su bsdus pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te tshogs yongs su bsdu bar bgyi'o/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi 'gron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /de skad lan gsum brjod do/ /gsum pa mjug gi cho ga la gnyis/ rang dga' ba bsgom pa dang / gzhan dga' ba bskyed pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ dang po rang don grub pas dga' ba bsgom pa ni/ de ring nas byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnyed pas sangs rgyas kyi sras su gyur pa'i phyir tshe don yod par gyur la slar yang mi'i lus phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur bas rang gi 'dod pa'i don grub pa re dga' snyam pa'i spro ba dang ldan par rjes zlos mdzod/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skye/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang / /rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ /zhes lan gcig brjod do/ /gnyis pa gzhan don grub pas dga' ba bsgom pa ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa thob zin gyis/ de'i phan yon 'di dag yid la soms la dga' bar gyis shig rjes zlos mi 'tshal/ 'gro ba'i 'chi bdag 'joms byed pa'i/ /bdud rtsi mchog kyang 'di yin no/ /'gro ba'i dbul ba sel ba yi/

/mi zad gter yang 'di yin no/ /'gro ba'i nad rab zhi byed pa'i/ /sman gyi mchog kyang 'di yin no/ /srid lam 'khyams shing dub pa yi/ /'gro ba ngal gso'i ljon shing yin/ /'gro ba thams cad ngan 'gro las/ /sgrol bar byed pa'i spyi stegs yin/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs gdung sel ba'i/ /sems kyi zla ba shar ba yin/ /'gro ba'i mi shes rab rib dag /dpyis 'byin nyi ma chen po yin/ /dam chos 'o ma bsrubs pa las/ /mar gyi nying khu phyung ba yin/ /'gro ba'i mgon po srid pa'i lam rgyu zhing / /bde ba'i longs spyod spyad par 'dod pa la/ /'di ni bde ba'i mchog tu nyer gnas te/ /sems can 'gron chen tshim par byed pa yin/ /zhes brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni bdag gis sems bskyed nas skye dgu thams cad kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don rdzogs par grub par bya yis sems can thams cad dga' bar mdzod cig ces sems la rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi/ /spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni/ /bar du bde la 'gron du bos zin gyis/ /lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis/ /zhes brjod do/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la gnyis/ bslab bya brjod pa dang / dge ba bsngo ba bya ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ sems nyams pa'i rgyu spong ba la bslab pa dang / sems mi nyams pa'i rgyu blang ba la bslab pa/ sems de khyad par du 'phel ba'i thabs gzhan la bslab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ byang chub kyi sems nyams par byed pa'i rgyu nag po'i chos bzhi spangs te dkar po'i chos bzhi la bslab par bya ste/ dkar po'i chos bzhi gang zhe na/ srog gi phyir yang bsams bzhin du brdzun mi smra ba la bslab pa dang / sems can kun la lhag pa'i bsam pas gnas par bya'i g.yo sgyus ma yin pa la bslab pa dang / sems bskyed pa'i byang sems la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed de phyogs bcur yon tan brjod pa dang /

sems can gang dge ba la dgod pa de dag thams cad sangs rgyas la dgod kyi nyan rang la ma yin pa la bslab par bya ba yin te/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa 'od srung gi le'u las ji skad gsungs pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po zhum pas sems gtong ba'i gnyen po la bslab pa ni/ sems zhum nas bdag lta bus sangs rgyas mi 'grub snyam nas sems gtong ba la/ de'i gnyen por mdo sde rgyan du/ gang dag sems can mir gyur pa/ /tshad med skad cig re re la/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa'i phyir/ /zhum pa dang du blang mi bya/ /zhes pa dang / spyod 'jug las/ zhum bcas rtsol ba dor ba la/ /phongs las thar pa yod dam ci/ /nga rgyal rtsol ba bskyed pa ni/ /chen po yis kyang thub par dka'/ /zhes dang / las dang nyon mongs nus pa ste/ /gsum po dag la nga rgyal bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don bsam zhing las kyi nga rgyal dang nyon mongs pa'i nga rgyal dang nus pa'i nga rgyal bsgoms la sems ma zhum zhing mi 'gong ba la bslab bo/ /gnyis pa sgyid lug pas byang chub kyi sems gtong ba'i gnyen po la bslab pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni dbang po rnon pos bskal pa grangs med du mar tshogs gnyis bsags shing mgo dang rkang lag gtong ba sogs bya dka' ba brgya phrag gis thob pa yin na bdag ni dbang po rtul zhing brtson 'grus zhan pas sangs rgyas ga la 'grub snyam nas sgyid lug nas sems gtong ba la/ bdag gis byang chub ga la zhes/ /sgyid lug par ni mi bya ste/ /'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /bden pa gsungs pas bden 'di gsungs/ /sbrang bu sha sbrang bung ba dang / /de bzhin srin bur gang gyur pa/ /des kyang brtson pa'i stobs bskyed na/ /byang chub thob dka' bla med thob/ /bdag lta rigs kyi mir skye la/ /phan dang gnod pa ngo shes nas/ /byang chub spyod pa ma btang na/ /bdag gis byang chub cis mi 'thob/ /ces dang / de bas skyo ngal kun sel ba'i/

/byang chub sems kyi rta zhon nas/ /bde nas bde bar 'gro ba la/ /sems shes su zhig sgyid lug 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don bsam ste spro ba bskyed pa la bslab par bya'o/ /gsum pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs la skrag nas byang chub kyi sems gtong ba'i gnyen po la bslab pa ni/ khams gsum pa'i rang bzhin rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur ma shes nas sdug bsngal la bden par bzung ste des skrag cing skyo nas sems gtong ba la chos thams cad bdag nyid kyis stong pas don dam par sdug bsngal ba po'i bdag med par shes pa dang sdug bsngal rmi lam lta bur shes pa dang / sdig pa spangs shing bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis lus bde ba dang / mkhas pa yid bde ba bskyed pa la bslab par bya ste/ spyod 'jug tu/ sdig pa spangs phyir sdug bsngal med/ /mkhas pa'i phyir na mi dga' med/ /'di ltar log par rtog pa dang / /sdig pas lus dang sems la gnod/ /bsod nams kyis ni lus bde la/ /mkhas pa yis ni sems bde na/ /gzhan don 'khor bar gnas kyang ni/ /snying rje ca dag ci ste skyo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la bslab par bya'o/ /tha na'ang nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub ma thob bar du nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i dge ba rtsa 'dis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa'am sngar gyi tshigs su bcad pa bzlas pas sems mngon du bya'o/ /rgyal po la gdams pa las/ rgyal po chen po 'di ltar khyod bya ba mang byed pa mang ste/ nyin mtshan du sbyin pa nas sher phyin gyi bar la slob par mi nus te/ de bas na rgyal po chen po khyod yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dad pa dang / don du gnyer ba dang / smon pa rtag tu dran par gyis la yid la zungs te sgoms shig gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang bar gyis/ rjes su yi rang nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos dang rang rgyal thams cad la phul cig

phul bas sems can thams cad dang thun mong du gyis shig de nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur bar nyin gcig bzhin du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sngos shig rgyal po chen po khyod de ltar byas na rgyal srid kyang byed la rgyal po'i bya ba'ang nyams par mi 'gyur zhing / byang chub kyi tshogs kyang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ gzhan yang sems can la byams snying rje bsgom pa dang / theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten pa dang / dkon mchog la dad pa bskyed pa dang / 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang / rang gcig pu zhi bde 'dod pa'i nyes dmigs bsams pa dang / byang chub kyi sems kyi phan yon dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul dang mthu la sogs pa che ba'i yon tan dran pa sogs byang chub kyi sems 'phel ba'i mthun rkyen rnams la bslab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsngo ba la chos lnga las/ dang po bsngo bya'i dge ba ni/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i dge bas thog drangs pa'i dge ba dus gsum dang 'brel ba thams cad de/ sdud pa las/ dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa nas/ /'dren pa rnams kyi dam chos zad kyi bar/ /de bar rgyal ba de dag bsod nams gang yin dang / /pha rol phyin gang ldan dang sangs rgyas chos gang dang / /gang yang sangs rgyas sras rnams dang ni nyan thos dang / /slob dang mi slob dge ba zag bcas zag med pa/ /zhes pa ltar yin no/ /gnyis pa ba sngo byed kyi sems ni/ rtag bdag gtsang ba der phyin ci log dang bral zhing / 'khor gsum du bden par mi dmigs shing mtshan 'dzin bral ba'i shes rab 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems kyis bsngos te/ sdud par/ gal te mtshan ma med na de ni byang chub bsngo ba yin/ /zhes dang / dmigs pa'i 'du shes can la yongs su bsngo ba de med do/ /zhes dang /

mgon po byams pas/ de ni dmigs med rnam pa can/ /phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid do/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ched du bya ba gzhan don du bsngo ba dang / bzhi pa bsngo sa rnam mkhyen kho na ste/ sdud par/ 'gro ba'i don rgyu byang chub phyir ni thams cad bsngo/ /zhes pa dang / yum las/ rab 'byor dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs pa nyan thos kyi sa'am rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug go /zhes pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa bsngos pa'i phan yon ni/ dge ba mi zad cing byang chub kyi rgyur bsgyur ba yin te/ mdo las/ ji ltar chu thigs rgya mtsho che nang lhung / /rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang / /byang chub ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad/ /ces so/ /de ltar bsngo ba'i chos de rnams thugs yul du mtshon/ mdor na dge ba'i rtsa ba sgyu ma lta bu 'di rnams la brten nas sems can sgyu ma lta bu rnams kyi ched du sangs rgyas sgyu ma lta bu thob par gyur cig snyam pa'i 'dun pas bdag gi rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang dge 'dun rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te/ /rga nad 'chi ba'i rlabs chen 'khrug pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba 'don par shog /ces dang / rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo pa/ /gang gi ming ni kun tu bzang zhes bgyi/ /mkhas pa de dang mtshungs par spyad pa'i phyir/ /dge ba 'di dag thams cad yongs su bsngo/ /zhes pa dang / phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i/ /sems can kun don sgrub pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs spyod mdzad pa/ /bdag gi spyod pa'ang de 'drar shog /ces pa dang / mthong zhing thos sam rjes su dran yang rung / /reg gam gtam du brjod par gyur kyang rung /

/rnam pa kun tu 'gro la phan pa ni/ /bde dang ldan par rtag tu byed gyur cig /ces pa dang / 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig /gtsug lag khang rnams klog pa dang / /kha ton gyis rgyas legs gnas shog /rtag tu dge 'dun mthun pa dang / /dge 'dun don yang 'grub gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ni/ /'gro don thugs la dgongs grub shog /mgon po yi ni gang dgongs pa/ /sems can rnams la'ang de 'byor shog /bsod nams stobs chen 'di yis mthus/ /sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ /tshe 'dir bsam pa'i don rnams kun/ /bar chad zhi nas bkra shis te/ /bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par shog /ces dang / sa dang chu dang me rlung dang / /rtsi dang nags kyi shing lta bur/ /rtag tu srog chags thams cad kyis/ /'dod dgu dpag med spyod par shog /mthong ba dang ni reg pa dang / /thos pa dang ni dran pas kyang / /bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi/ /nad rnams gso bar bgyid gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stongs byed pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag su bzhugs pa/ /de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub gyur cig /ces brjod par bya'o/ /rgyal sras kun gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /byang chub khang bzang 'dzeg pa'i them skas mchog /don gnyis phun tshogs dpag yas nor bu'i gling / /bde legs kun 'byung rin chen byang chub sems/ /rtsal ldan zhi ba'i lha dang dze tā ri/ /klu sgrub snying po la sogs mkhas grub kyi/ /dgongs pa ji bzhin so so'i gzhung las btus/ /nyes pa mchis na mkhas rnams bzod par mdzod/ /dge bas 'gro ba'i rgud pa kun bsal te/ /skye dgus byang chub chen po legs thob nas/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus mthar byas te/ /rgyal ba'i phrin las dpag yas mthar phyin shog

/smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga theg chen lam gyi snying po zhes bya ba 'di ni/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / mkhan po chen po zhi ba'i lha dang / slob dpon byang chub bzang po dang / dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba dang / jo bo rje la sogs pas mdzad pa'i cho ga rnams dang / gzhan yang mdo dang / mkhas grub rnams kyi bstan bcos so so la brten nas chos smra ba'i dge slong mang du thos pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ 'gal byed can gyi lo khra'i zla ba'i nyi shu lnga la/ dpal sa skya'i dgon par yongs su rdzogs par grub pa'i yi ge pa blo gros mtshungs med kyis bgyis so/ /dge'o/ gcig zhus// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 bla ma dam pa/ smon pa sems bskyed theg chen lam gyi snying po/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
